claims.statement: Management expects to reach the USD 2 billion run rate by FY27.
claims.quote: the $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.

claims.statement: Management clarifies that the USD 2 billion target refers to the Q4 exit run rate in FY27.
claims.quote: Correct. So, on the last part, FY’27, Q4 exit is where we are looking at the run rate being in the range of $500 million or so.

facts.statement: The BFSI vertical demonstrated a year-on-year growth of 24.4% for Q4 with an annualized run rate of USD 600 million.

facts.statement: For the full financial year FY26, the BFSI vertical revenue growth was 28.4% year-on-year.
facts.quote: With respect to full FY26 financial year, the revenue growth came at 28.4% year-on-year, a result of expanding relationships with our existing customers and new client wins across North America, Europe and Australia.
